hypothesis: Lagged short Treasury yield and term spread provide interest-rate information absent from own-stock, sector, SPY-relative and VIX features; source readiness does not establish trading value
provider: U.S. Treasury official annual daily par yield XML
formulas: BC_10YEAR minus BC_2YEAR in percentage points
availability: Research assumption: second XNYS session strictly after Treasury observation date, at that session close plus15minutes. Treasury usually publishes by18:00ET but warns of delays. Historical timestamps and revisions are unverified; never claim exact point-in-time fidelity.
join: Backward as-of to latest actual eligible observation; no synthetic/interpolated yield or feed fallback. Explicit bounded age permits Treasury/NYSE holiday differences; report all age/gap counts.
methodology_change: 2021-12-06: retain reported historical values and report coverage separately before/after change; no backcasting or smoothing across methods
redirects_or_pagination_or_all_years: reject; annual requests only; do not follow links into2024 onward
access_failure: stop on first HTTP/schema/source failure, retain evidence, no automatic retry or alternate source
missing_fields: retain explicit missing/null rows for coverage; never zero-fill or replace maturities
failure: Close this fixed source proposal if coverage/access fails; no maturity/lag/staleness/gate grid or automatic retry. Any model comparison needs separate matched preregistration after source acceptance.
